text_block_list.text:
I've been so absorbed in my work<n>that I lose track
of time. As I rush<n>back home, I run into someone
familiar...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh? What are you still doing here,<n>Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Don't tell me you've been out here training this
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I just can't stop thinking about the<n>race... I thought
running would take<n>my mind off of it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But... no such luck. I'm not sure what<n>else to try...

She seems exhausted from her race...<n>It might be
time to adjust her<n>schedule so she can take a
break.
